passages.text: Hear now, O Israel, the statutes and ordinances I am teaching you to follow, so that you may live and may enter and take possession of the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, is giving you.
passages.sermon:
Israel, listen now.
I am teaching you statutes and ordinances.
You must do them.
If you do them, you will live.
You will enter the land.
You will take possession of the land.
The LORD is giving you this land.
The LORD is the God of your fathers.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שְׁמַ֤ע אֶל־ הַֽחֻקִּים֙ וְאֶל־ הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָֽנֹכִ֛י מְלַמֵּ֥ד אֶתְכֶ֖ם לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת לְמַ֣עַן תִּֽחְי֗וּ וּבָאתֶם֙ וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You must not add to or subtract from what I command you, so that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God that I am giving you.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to Israel.
Moses gave commands from the LORD God.
Do not add anything to these commands.
Do not take anything away from these commands.
Keep the commandments of the LORD your God.
I am giving you these commandments now.
passages.original: לֹ֣א תֹסִ֗פוּ עַל־ הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָנֹכִי֙ מְצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תִגְרְע֖וּ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ לִשְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת־ מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did at Baal-peor, for the LORD your God destroyed from among you all who followed Baal of Peor.
passages.sermon:
Israel, you saw what happened at Baal-peor.
The LORD is your God.
The LORD acted at Baal-peor.
The LORD destroyed every person who followed Baal of Peor.
The LORD removed them from among you.
passages.original: עֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ הָֽרֹאֹ֔ת אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה בְּבַ֣עַל פְּע֑וֹר כִּ֣י כָל־ הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָלַךְ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י בַֽעַל־ פְּע֔וֹר הִשְׁמִיד֛וֹ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: But you who held fast to the LORD your God are alive to this day, every one of you.
passages.sermon:
You hold fast to the LORD your God.
You remain loyal to Him.
You are all alive today.
Every one of you lives because you stayed close to God.
passages.original: וְאַתֶּם֙ הַדְּבֵקִ֔ים בַּיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם חַיִּ֥ים כֻּלְּכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃

passages.text: See, I have taught you statutes and ordinances just as the LORD my God has commanded me, so that you may follow them in the land that you are about to enter and possess.
passages.sermon:
Moses is speaking to the people of Israel.
Moses says, "Look."
I have taught you statutes.
I have taught you ordinances.
The LORD is my God.
The LORD my God commanded me to teach you these statutes and ordinances.
You are about to enter a land.
You will possess this land.
You must do these statutes and ordinances in that land.
passages.original: רְאֵ֣ה׀ לִמַּ֣דְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֗ם חֻקִּים֙ וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוַּ֖נִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת כֵּ֔ן בְּקֶ֣רֶב הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם בָּאִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: Observe them carefully, for this will show your wisdom and understanding in the sight of the peoples, who will hear of all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel His statutes and laws.
God commanded Israel to keep and do these laws.
You must observe these laws carefully.
When you obey, you show wisdom.
You also show understanding.
Other nations will see your actions.
Other nations will hear about all these laws.
They will say, “This great nation is wise.”
They will say, “This great nation is understanding.”
passages.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֮ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם֒ כִּ֣י הִ֤וא חָכְמַתְכֶם֙ וּבִ֣ינַתְכֶ֔ם לְעֵינֵ֖י הָעַמִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁמְע֗וּן אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הַחֻקִּ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְאָמְר֗וּ רַ֚ק עַם־ חָכָ֣ם וְנָב֔וֹן הַגּ֥וֹי הַגָּד֖וֹל הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: For what nation is great enough to have a god as near to them as the LORD our God is to us whenever we call on Him?
passages.sermon:
Israel is a nation.
The LORD is Israel’s God.
The LORD is near to Israel.
The LORD comes close whenever Israel calls to Him.
No other nation has a god so near to them.
No other nation has a god who answers whenever they call.
passages.original: כִּ֚י מִי־ ג֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר־ ל֥וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים קְרֹבִ֣ים אֵלָ֑יו כַּיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ בְּכָּל־ קָרְאֵ֖נוּ אֵלָֽיו׃

passages.text: And what nation is great enough to have righteous statutes and ordinances like this entire law I set before you today?
passages.sermon:
Israel is a great nation.
God gave Israel laws and rules.
These laws are righteous.
These rules are just.
No other nation has laws as righteous as these.
Today, God sets this whole law before Israel.
passages.original: וּמִי֙ גּ֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר־ ל֛וֹ חֻקִּ֥ים וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֖ים צַדִּיקִ֑ם כְּכֹל֙ הַתּוֹרָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃

passages.text: Only be on your guard and diligently watch yourselves, so that you do not forget the things your eyes have seen, and so that they do not slip from your heart as long as you live. Teach them to your children and grandchildren.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel at Mount Horeb.
God gave them His law and His words.
God told them to be careful.
God told them to guard their lives closely.
Do not forget what you have seen with your own eyes.
Do not let these things leave your heart as long as you live.
Teach these things to your children.
Teach these things to your grandchildren.
passages.original: רַ֡ק הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֩ וּשְׁמֹ֨ר נַפְשְׁךָ֜ מְאֹ֗ד פֶּן־ תִּשְׁכַּ֨ח אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר־ רָא֣וּ עֵינֶ֗יךָ וּפֶן־ יָס֙וּרוּ֙ מִלְּבָ֣בְךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּ֑יךָ וְהוֹדַעְתָּ֥ם לְבָנֶ֖יךָ וְלִבְנֵ֥י בָנֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: The day you stood before the LORD your God at Horeb, the LORD said to me, “Gather the people before Me to hear My words, so that they may learn to fear Me all the days they live on the earth, and that they may teach them to their children.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
You stood before Him at Horeb.
Horeb is a mountain where God spoke to Israel.
On that day, the LORD spoke to me.
He said, “Gather the people before Me.”
He wanted the people to hear His words.
He wanted them to learn to fear Him.
They must fear Him all the days they live on the earth.
They must also teach their children to fear Him.
passages.original: י֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָמַ֜דְתָּ לִפְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶיךָ֮ בְּחֹרֵב֒ בֶּאֱמֹ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י הַקְהֶל־ לִי֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם וְאַשְׁמִעֵ֖ם אֶת־ דְּבָרָ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִלְמְד֜וּן לְיִרְאָ֣ה אֹתִ֗י כָּל־ הַיָּמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵ֤ם חַיִּים֙ עַל־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה וְאֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם יְלַמֵּדֽוּן׃

passages.text: You came near and stood at the base of the mountain, a mountain blazing with fire to the heavens, with black clouds and deep darkness.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel came near to Mount Horeb.
They stood at the base of the mountain.
The mountain was blazing with fire.
The fire reached up to the heart of the heavens.
There were black clouds over the mountain.
There was deep darkness surrounding the mountain.
passages.original: וַתִּקְרְב֥וּן וַתַּֽעַמְד֖וּן תַּ֣חַת הָהָ֑ר וְהָהָ֞ר בֹּעֵ֤ר בָּאֵשׁ֙ עַד־ לֵ֣ב הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם חֹ֖שֶׁךְ עָנָ֥ן וַעֲרָפֶֽל׃

passages.text: And the LORD spoke to you out of the fire. You heard the sound of the words, but saw no form; there was only a voice.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD spoke to you.
He spoke from the midst of the fire.
You heard the sound of words.
You did not see any form.
You saw nothing but heard a voice.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם מִתּ֣וֹךְ הָאֵ֑שׁ ק֤וֹל דְּבָרִים֙ אַתֶּ֣ם שֹׁמְעִ֔ים וּתְמוּנָ֛ה אֵינְכֶ֥ם רֹאִ֖ים זוּלָתִ֥י קֽוֹל׃

passages.text: He declared to you His covenant, which He commanded you to follow—the Ten Commandments that He wrote on two tablets of stone.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to you at Mount Horeb.
He told you about His covenant.
He commanded you to keep this covenant.
This covenant is the Ten Commandments.
The LORD wrote the Ten Commandments on two stone tablets.
passages.original: וַיַּגֵּ֨ד לָכֶ֜ם אֶת־ בְּרִית֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה אֶתְכֶם֙ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת עֲשֶׂ֖רֶת הַדְּבָרִ֑ים וַֽיִּכְתְּבֵ֔ם עַל־ שְׁנֵ֖י לֻח֥וֹת אֲבָנִֽים׃

passages.text: At that time the LORD commanded me to teach you the statutes and ordinances you are to follow in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD spoke to me at that time.
The LORD gave me a command.
He told me to teach you.
I must teach you statutes and ordinances.
You must do these statutes and ordinances.
You will do them in the land.
You are crossing the Jordan River.
You will possess that land.
passages.original: וְאֹתִ֞י צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא לְלַמֵּ֣ד אֶתְכֶ֔ם חֻקִּ֖ים וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֑ים לַעֲשֹׂתְכֶ֣ם אֹתָ֔ם בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: So since you saw no form of any kind on the day the LORD spoke to you out of the fire at Horeb, be careful that you do not act corruptly and make an idol for yourselves of any form or shape, whether in the likeness of a male or female, of any beast that is on the earth or bird that flies in the air, or of any creature that crawls on the ground or fish that is in the waters below.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God spoke to you at Horeb.
God spoke to you from the fire.
You did not see any form that day.
Be very careful to protect your lives.
Do not act corruptly.
Do not make an idol for yourselves.
Do not make any image or shape.
Do not make an image of a man.
Do not make an image of a woman.
Do not make an image of any animal on the earth.
Do not make an image of any bird that flies in the sky.
Do not make an image of anything that crawls on the ground.
Do not make an image of any fish in the waters under the earth.
passages.original: וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם מְאֹ֖ד לְנַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֣י לֹ֤א רְאִיתֶם֙ כָּל־ תְּמוּנָ֔ה בְּי֗וֹם דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֲלֵיכֶ֛ם בְּחֹרֵ֖ב מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ׃ פֶּ֨ן־ תַּשְׁחִת֔וּן וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֥ם לָכֶ֛ם פֶּ֖סֶל תְּמוּנַ֣ת כָּל־ סָ֑מֶל תַּבְנִ֥ית זָכָ֖ר א֥וֹ נְקֵבָֽה׃ תַּבְנִ֕ית כָּל־ בְּהֵמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּאָ֑רֶץ תַּבְנִית֙ כָּל־ צִפּ֣וֹר כָּנָ֔ף אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּע֖וּף בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃ תַּבְנִ֕ית כָּל־ רֹמֵ֖שׂ בָּאֲדָמָ֑ה תַּבְנִ֛ית כָּל־ דָּגָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר־ בַּמַּ֖יִם מִתַּ֥חַת לָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: When you look to the heavens and see the sun and moon and stars—all the host of heaven—do not be enticed to bow down and worship what the LORD your God has apportioned to all the nations under heaven.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He created the heavens.
You may look up and see the sky.
You may see the sun.
You may see the moon.
You may see the stars.
You may see all the host of heaven.
Do not let your heart be led astray.
Do not bow down to the sun, the moon, or the stars.
Do not worship them.
The LORD your God has given these things to all the nations under heaven.
They are not for you to worship.
passages.original: וּפֶן־ תִּשָּׂ֨א עֵינֶ֜יךָ הַשָּׁמַ֗יְמָה וְֽ֠רָאִיתָ אֶת־ הַשֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ וְאֶת־ הַיָּרֵ֜חַ וְאֶת־ הַכּֽוֹכָבִ֗ים כֹּ֚ל צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְנִדַּחְתָּ֛ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם וַעֲבַדְתָּ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָלַ֜ק יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֹתָ֔ם לְכֹל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים תַּ֖חַת כָּל־ הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Yet the LORD has taken you and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be the people of His inheritance, as you are today.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD took you.
He brought you out of Egypt.
Egypt was like an iron furnace.
He did this so you would be His own people.
You are His special inheritance.
You are His people today.
passages.original: וְאֶתְכֶם֙ לָקַ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה וַיּוֹצִ֥א אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִכּ֥וּר הַבַּרְזֶ֖ל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם לִהְי֥וֹת ל֛וֹ לְעַ֥ם נַחֲלָ֖ה כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: The LORD, however, was angry with me on account of you, and He swore that I would not cross the Jordan to enter the good land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.
passages.sermon:
Moses is speaking to the people of Israel.
The LORD became angry with me because of you.
The LORD swore an oath.
He said I would not cross the Jordan River.
He said I would not enter the good land.
The LORD your God is giving you this good land.
He is giving it to you as an inheritance.
passages.original: וַֽיהוָ֥ה הִתְאַנֶּף־ בִּ֖י עַל־ דִּבְרֵיכֶ֑ם וַיִּשָּׁבַ֗ע לְבִלְתִּ֤י עָבְרִי֙ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וּלְבִלְתִּי־ בֹא֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ נַחֲלָֽה׃

passages.text: For I will not be crossing the Jordan, because I must die in this land. But you shall cross over and take possession of that good land.
passages.sermon:
Moses is speaking to the people of Israel.
Moses will die in this land.
Moses will not cross the Jordan River.
The people of Israel will cross the Jordan River.
The people of Israel will take possession of the good land.
passages.original: כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֥י מֵת֙ בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את אֵינֶ֥נִּי עֹבֵ֖ר אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְאַתֶּם֙ עֹֽבְרִ֔ים וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֕ם אֶת־ הָאָ֥רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

passages.text: Be careful that you do not forget the covenant of the LORD your God that He made with you; do not make an idol for yourselves in the form of anything He has forbidden you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He made a covenant with you.
Be careful.
Do not forget this covenant.
Do not make an idol for yourselves.
Do not make any image or form.
The LORD your God has forbidden this.
passages.original: הִשָּׁמְר֣וּ לָכֶ֗ם פֶּֽן־ תִּשְׁכְּחוּ֙ אֶת־ בְּרִ֤ית יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖ת עִמָּכֶ֑ם וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם לָכֶ֥ם פֶּ֙סֶל֙ תְּמ֣וּנַת כֹּ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: For the LORD your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.
passages.sermon: The LORD is your God.\r\nThe LORD is a consuming fire.\r\nThe LORD is a jealous God.
passages.original: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֵ֥שׁ אֹכְלָ֖ה ה֑וּא אֵ֖ל קַנָּֽא׃פ

passages.text: After you have children and grandchildren and you have been in the land a long time, if you then act corruptly and make an idol of any form—doing evil in the sight of the LORD your God and provoking Him to anger— I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you this day that you will quickly perish from the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess. You will not live long upon it, but will be utterly destroyed.
passages.sermon:
You are the people of Israel.
The LORD your God brought you into the land.
You will have children and grandchildren.
You will live in the land for a long time.
If you become corrupt, you will do wrong.
If you make an idol in any form, you will sin.
You will do evil in the sight of the LORD your God.
You will make the LORD your God angry.
Today, I call heaven and earth to witness against you.
You will quickly perish from the land.
You are crossing the Jordan to possess this land.
You will not live long in the land.
You will be completely destroyed.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ תוֹלִ֤יד בָּנִים֙ וּבְנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים וְנוֹשַׁנְתֶּ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְהִשְׁחַתֶּ֗ם וַעֲשִׂ֤יתֶם פֶּ֙סֶל֙ תְּמ֣וּנַת כֹּ֔ל וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֥ם הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה־ אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לְהַכְעִיסֽוֹ׃ הַעִידֹתִי֩ בָכֶ֨ם הַיּ֜וֹם אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־ הָאָ֗רֶץ כִּֽי־ אָבֹ֣ד תֹּאבֵדוּן֮ מַהֵר֒ מֵעַ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֧ים אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ לֹֽא־ תַאֲרִיכֻ֤ן יָמִים֙ עָלֶ֔יהָ כִּ֥י הִשָּׁמֵ֖ד תִּשָּׁמֵדֽוּן׃

passages.text: Then the LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and only a few of you will survive among the nations to which the LORD will drive you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will scatter you among many peoples.
The LORD will drive you to different nations.
Only a few of you will survive in those nations.
passages.original: וְהֵפִ֧יץ יְהוָ֛ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּעַמִּ֑ים וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם֙ מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר בַּגּוֹיִ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְנַהֵ֧ג יְהוָ֛ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם שָֽׁמָּה׃

passages.text: And there you will serve man-made gods of wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or eat or smell.
passages.sermon:
The LORD will scatter you among the nations.
You will live in foreign lands.
There you will serve gods made by people.
These gods are made of wood and stone.
They cannot see.
They cannot hear.
They cannot eat.
They cannot smell.
passages.original: וַעֲבַדְתֶּם־ שָׁ֣ם אֱלֹהִ֔ים מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָ֑ם עֵ֣ץ וָאֶ֔בֶן אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ יִרְאוּן֙ וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁמְע֔וּן וְלֹ֥א יֹֽאכְל֖וּן וְלֹ֥א יְרִיחֻֽן׃

passages.text: But if from there you will seek the LORD your God, you will find Him if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul.
passages.sermon:
You are far from your homeland.
You are among the nations where the LORD your God has sent you.
If you seek the LORD your God from there, you will find Him.
You must seek Him with all your heart.
You must seek Him with all your soul.
passages.original: וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּ֥ם מִשָּׁ֛ם אֶת־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ וּמָצָ֑אתָ כִּ֣י תִדְרְשֶׁ֔נּוּ בְּכָל־ לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכָל־ נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃

passages.text: When you are in distress and all these things have happened to you, then in later days you will return to the LORD your God and listen to His voice.
passages.sermon:
You will face distress.
All these things will happen to you.
This will happen in the later days.
Then you will return to the LORD your God.
You will listen to His voice.
passages.original: בַּצַּ֣ר לְךָ֔ וּמְצָא֕וּךָ כֹּ֖ל הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה בְּאַחֲרִית֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים וְשַׁבְתָּ֙ עַד־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֖ בְּקֹלֽוֹ׃

passages.text: For the LORD your God is a merciful God; He will not abandon you or destroy you or forget the covenant with your fathers, which He swore to them by oath.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD is merciful.
The LORD will not abandon you.
The LORD will not destroy you.
The LORD will not forget the covenant with your fathers.
The LORD swore this covenant to your fathers by oath.
passages.original: כִּ֣י אֵ֤ל רַחוּם֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לֹ֥א יַרְפְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֣א יַשְׁחִיתֶ֑ךָ וְלֹ֤א יִשְׁכַּח֙ אֶת־ בְּרִ֣ית אֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Indeed, ask now from one end of the heavens to the other about the days that long preceded you, from the day that God created man on earth: Has anything as great as this ever happened or been reported?
passages.sermon:
God created man on the earth.
This happened long ago.
Look at all the days that came before you.
Ask about them.
Ask from one end of the heavens to the other end.
Has anything this great ever happened?
Has anyone ever heard of something like this?
passages.original: כִּ֣י שְׁאַל־ נָא֩ לְיָמִ֨ים רִֽאשֹׁנִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר־ הָי֣וּ לְפָנֶ֗יךָ לְמִן־ הַיּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁר֩ בָּרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ אָדָם֙ עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וּלְמִקְצֵ֥ה הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְעַד־ קְצֵ֣ה הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם הֲנִֽהְיָ֗ה כַּדָּבָ֤ר הַגָּדוֹל֙ הַזֶּ֔ה א֖וֹ הֲנִשְׁמַ֥ע כָּמֹֽהוּ׃

passages.text: Has a people ever heard the voice of God speaking out of the fire, as you have, and lived?
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God spoke with a voice from the fire.
You heard God’s voice from the fire.
You lived after hearing God’s voice.
No other people have heard God speak from the fire and lived.
passages.original: הֲשָׁ֣מַֽע עָם֩ ק֨וֹל אֱלֹהִ֜ים מְדַבֵּ֧ר מִתּוֹךְ־ הָאֵ֛שׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר־ שָׁמַ֥עְתָּ אַתָּ֖ה וַיֶּֽחִי׃

passages.text: Or has any god tried to take as his own a nation out of another nation—by trials, signs, wonders, and war, by a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and by great terrors—as the LORD your God did for you in Egypt, before your eyes?
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He acted with great power.
He brought you out of Egypt.
He did this before your eyes.
He took you, a nation, out from the midst of another nation.
He used trials.
He showed signs.
He performed wonders.
He fought with war.
He used a strong hand.
He stretched out His arm.
He brought great terrors.
No other god has ever tried to do this.
passages.original: א֣וֹ׀ הֲנִסָּ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֗ים לָ֠בוֹא לָקַ֨חַת ל֣וֹ גוֹי֮ מִקֶּ֣רֶב גּוֹי֒ בְּמַסֹּת֩ בְּאֹתֹ֨ת וּבְמוֹפְתִ֜ים וּבְמִלְחָמָ֗ה וּבְיָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּבְמוֹרָאִ֖ים גְּדֹלִ֑ים כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם לְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: You were shown these things so that you would know that the LORD is God; there is no other besides Him.
passages.sermon:
God showed you these things.
He wanted you to know Him.
The LORD is God.
There is no other God besides Him.
passages.original: אַתָּה֙ הָרְאֵ֣תָ לָדַ֔עַת כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה ה֣וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֥ין ע֖וֹד מִלְבַדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He let you hear His voice from heaven to discipline you, and on earth He showed you His great fire, and you heard His words out of the fire.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God spoke to you from heaven.
God let you hear His voice.
God did this to teach and discipline you.
God showed you His great fire on earth.
You saw this fire with your own eyes.
You heard God's words from inside the fire.
passages.original: מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם הִשְׁמִֽיעֲךָ֥ אֶת־ קֹל֖וֹ לְיַסְּרֶ֑ךָּ וְעַל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ הֶרְאֲךָ֙ אֶת־ אִשּׁ֣וֹ הַגְּדוֹלָ֔ה וּדְבָרָ֥יו שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: Because He loved your fathers, He chose their descendants after them and brought you out of Egypt by His presence and great power, to drive out before you nations greater and mightier than you, and to bring you into their land and give it to you for your inheritance, as it is this day.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He loved your fathers.
He chose their descendants after them.
He brought you out of Egypt.
He did this by His presence and great power.
He drove out nations before you.
These nations were greater and mightier than you.
He brought you into their land.
He gave you their land as your inheritance.
He did this as it is today.
passages.original: וְתַ֗חַת כִּ֤י אָהַב֙ אֶת־ אֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ וַיִּבְחַ֥ר בְּזַרְע֖וֹ אַחֲרָ֑יו וַיּוֹצִֽאֲךָ֧ בְּפָנָ֛יו בְּכֹח֥וֹ הַגָּדֹ֖ל מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃ לְהוֹרִ֗ישׁ גּוֹיִ֛ם גְּדֹלִ֧ים וַעֲצֻמִ֛ים מִמְּךָ֖ מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ לַהֲבִֽיאֲךָ֗ לָֽתֶת־ לְךָ֧ אֶת־ אַרְצָ֛ם נַחֲלָ֖ה כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Know therefore this day and take to heart that the LORD is God in heaven above and on the earth below; there is no other.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He rules in heaven above.
He rules on the earth below.
There is no other God.
Know this today.
Take this truth into your heart.
passages.original: וְיָדַעְתָּ֣ הַיּ֗וֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ֮ אֶל־ לְבָבֶךָ֒ כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם מִמַּ֔עַל וְעַל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ מִתָּ֑חַת אֵ֖ין עֽוֹד׃

passages.text: Keep His statutes and commandments, which I am giving you today, so that you and your children after you may prosper, and that you may live long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you for all time.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God gives you the land.
God gives you this land for all time.
I am giving you statutes and commandments today.
Keep these statutes.
Keep these commandments.
If you keep them, it will go well for you.
It will go well for your children after you.
You will live long in the land.
passages.original: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֞ אֶת־ חֻקָּ֣יו וְאֶת־ מִצְוֺתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֤י מְצַוְּךָ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר֙ יִיטַ֣ב לְךָ֔ וּלְבָנֶ֖יךָ אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ וּלְמַ֨עַן תַּאֲרִ֤יךְ יָמִים֙ עַל־ הַ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃פ

passages.text: Then Moses set aside three cities across the Jordan to the east to which a manslayer could flee after killing his neighbor unintentionally without prior malice. To save one’s own life, he could flee to one of these cities: Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau belonging to the Reubenites, Ramoth in Gilead belonging to the Gadites, or Golan in Bashan belonging to the Manassites.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
He set aside three cities.
These cities were across the Jordan River.
They were to the east, where the sun rises.
A person could kill his neighbor by accident.
He might not have hated his neighbor before.
He did not plan to kill.
This person could run to one of these cities.
He could save his life there.
The first city was Bezer.
Bezer was in the wilderness.
It was on the plateau.
It belonged to the tribe of Reuben.
The second city was Ramoth.
Ramoth was in Gilead.
It belonged to the tribe of Gad.
The third city was Golan.
Golan was in Bashan.
It belonged to the tribe of Manasseh.
passages.original: אָ֣ז יַבְדִּ֤יל מֹשֶׁה֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ עָרִ֔ים בְּעֵ֖בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן מִזְרְחָ֖ה שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃ לָנֻ֨ס שָׁ֜מָּה רוֹצֵ֗חַ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְצַ֤ח אֶת־ רֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ בִּבְלִי־ דַ֔עַת וְה֛וּא לֹא־ שֹׂנֵ֥א ל֖וֹ מִתְּמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשׁ֑וֹם וְנָ֗ס אֶל־ אַחַ֛ת מִן־ הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖ל וָחָֽי׃ אֶת־ בֶּ֧צֶר בַּמִּדְבָּ֛ר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ הַמִּישֹׁ֖ר לָרֻֽאוּבֵנִ֑י וְאֶת־ רָאמֹ֤ת בַּגִּלְעָד֙ לַגָּדִ֔י וְאֶת־ גּוֹלָ֥ן בַּבָּשָׁ֖ן לַֽמְנַשִּֽׁי׃

passages.text: This is the law that Moses set before the Israelites.
passages.sermon: Moses was the leader of the Israelites.\r\nMoses gave the Israelites God’s law.\r\nThis is the law that Moses set before the Israelites.
passages.original: וְזֹ֖את הַתּוֹרָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֣ם מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: These are the testimonies, statutes, and ordinances that Moses proclaimed to them after they had come out of Egypt, while they were in the valley across the Jordan facing Beth-peor in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon and was defeated by Moses and the Israelites after they had come out of Egypt.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Moses spoke to the Israelites after they left Egypt.
He gave them testimonies, statutes, and ordinances.
He spoke these words in the valley across the Jordan River.
This place was opposite Beth-peor.
It was in the land of Sihon, king of the Amorites.
Sihon lived in Heshbon.
Moses and the Israelites defeated Sihon after they left Egypt.
passages.original: אֵ֚לֶּה הָֽעֵדֹ֔ת וְהַֽחֻקִּ֖ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּצֵאתָ֖ם מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃ בְּעֵ֨בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֜ן בַּגַּ֗יְא מ֚וּל בֵּ֣ית פְּע֔וֹר בְּאֶ֗רֶץ סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֤ה מֹשֶׁה֙ וּבְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּצֵאתָ֖ם מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: They took possession of the land belonging to Sihon and to Og king of Bashan—the two Amorite kings across the Jordan to the east— extending from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley as far as Mount Siyon (that is, Hermon), including all the Arabah on the east side of the Jordan and as far as the Sea of the Arabah, below the slopes of Pisgah.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites took land from Sihon and Og.
Sihon was king of the Amorites.
Og was king of Bashan.
These two kings ruled east of the Jordan River.
The Israelites took all their land.
The land stretched from Aroer.
Aroer is on the edge of the Arnon Valley.
The land reached to Mount Siyon.
Mount Siyon is also called Hermon.
The Israelites also took all the Arabah.
The Arabah is east of the Jordan River.
The land reached to the Sea of the Arabah.
This sea is below the slopes of Pisgah.
passages.original: וַיִּֽירְשׁ֨וּ אֶת־ אַרְצ֜וֹ וְאֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ׀ ע֣וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ־ הַבָּשָׁ֗ן שְׁנֵי֙ מַלְכֵ֣י הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן מִזְרַ֖ח שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃ מֵעֲרֹעֵ֞ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל־ שְׂפַת־ נַ֧חַל אַרְנֹ֛ן וְעַד־ הַ֥ר שִׂיאֹ֖ן ה֥וּא חֶרְמֽוֹן׃ וְכָל־ הָ֨עֲרָבָ֜ה עֵ֤בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה וְעַ֖ד יָ֣ם הָעֲרָבָ֑ה תַּ֖חַת אַשְׁדֹּ֥ת הַפִּסְגָּֽה׃פ
